add_default_dances: add default jump and head bob dances to the agent's memory using DanceNode
generate_sequential_move_fn: generate a move function from a sequence of dance steps for the agent to perform
Movement_class: create a Movement object with an agent and move function to get sequential dance moves
Movement_get_move: get the next move from a Movement object by calling its move function with the agent
RefObjMovement_class: create a RefObjMovement to navigate an agent clockwise or anticlockwise around a reference object
